correctness.rationale: Every Fq-linear associative derivation of M_n is inner ad(A) modulo scalar matrices, verified by the matrix-unit proof. Odd characteristic: an idempotent ad(A) has spectrum in {0,1}, opposite eigenvalue differences force a single eigenvalue, making ad(A) nilpotent as well as idempotent and hence zero. Characteristic 2: ad(A)^2=ad(A^2), so A^2+A=cI, splitting by the Artin–Schreier coset. Split projections yield {n choose r}_q q^{r(n-r)} counts paired by complementary projections, ranks 2r(n-r). A nonsplit quadratic extension exists only at even n=2m, has rank n^2/2 and orbit GL_n(q)/(2 GL_m(q^2)). Independent direct GF(2) enumeration of ALL normalized generators with A_00=0 verified n=2:1+4z^2, n=3:1+28z^4, n=4:1+120z^6+336z^8, including direct ad∘ad tests. The odd-characteristic assertion follows symbolically, not from GF2 counts.
